children.name: Dipteris chinensis
children.description: The native range of this species is S. China to N. Indo-China.

children.name: Dipteris conjugata
children.description: The native range of this species is Indo-China to S. Nansei-shotō and Pacific. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Dipteris lobbiana
children.description: The native range of this species is W. & C. Malesia. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Dipteris nieuwenhuisii
children.description: The native range of this species is Borneo.

children.name: Dipteris novoguineensis
children.description: The native range of this species is Borneo, S. Sulawesi, New Guinea.

children.name: Dipteris papilioniformis
children.description: The native range of this species is Sulawesi.

children.name: Dipteris shenzhenensis
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Guangdong). It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Dipteris wallichii
children.description: The native range of this species is Himalaya to Myanmar. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Cheiropleuria bicuspis
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. & Subtrop. Asia. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Cheiropleuria integrifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Guangdong, Guangxi), SC. & S. Japan to Taiwan. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Cheiropleuria parva
children.description: The native range of this species is Borneo.
